author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 우리나라에서는 지금까지 기록이 10건이 안 되는 길잃은새로, 2000년 5월과 11월 가거도, 2008년 5월 외연도 등 바닷가 섬에서 관찰되었다. 스페인에서 몽골에 이르는 유라시아의 나무가 드문 트인 땅에서 번식하고, 사하라 사막 남쪽 아프리카에서 겨울을 나는 먼 거리 철새이다. 번식기에는 곤충을, 이동기와 겨울에는 주로 씨앗을 먹는다.

points.en: greenish olive-grey head and upper breast (male)
orange-brown lower breast, belly and flanks (male)

sexes.male: 수컷은 머리와 윗가슴이 올리브빛 회색이고 멱과 뺨선이 노르스름하며, 노란 눈테가 또렷하다.
sexes.female: 암컷은 머리가 갈색을 띠고 머리꼭대기에 세로줄이 있으며, 멱과 윗가슴이 크림색 바탕에 가는 갈색 세로줄이 있다.

young: 어린새는 암컷보다 더 칙칙하고 가슴 전체에 검은 세로줄이 뚜렷하며, 흰 눈테와 흰 뺨선이 잘 보인다. 첫겨울 새는 등과 허리에 세로줄이 많고 날개띠가 엷으며 부리가 분홍색이다.

art.subject: Ortolan Bunting (Emberiza hortulana), adult male in spring, a migrant on a Korean offshore island: head, nape and breast band plain olive-grey; a conspicuous pale yellowish-white eye-ring; moustachial stripe and throat pale yellow, separated by a thin olive-grey malar line; mantle brown with dark streaks; rump plain greyish-brown; wings brown with rufous-buff fringes and two buff wing bars; belly, flanks and undertail coverts warm cinnamon-orange; tail dark brown with white on the outer feathers. Bill pink and conical; eye dark; legs pink.
art.pose: foraging on bare ground among short grass, side view
art.scene: short grass and bare earth beside small fields on a Korean offshore island during spring migration (May), clear light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male in spring, side view perched upright: greenish olive-grey head and upper breast, conspicuous pale creamy-yellow eye-ring, yellow submoustachial stripe and throat divided by an olive-grey malar line, pink conical bill, streaked brown back and wings, orange-brown lower breast, belly and flanks, pink legs

adult female in spring, side view on the ground: duller head without the green tone, brown crown with dark streaks, creamy eye-ring, creamy submoustachial stripe and throat with a dark malar stripe, paler breast with fine dark streaks, pink bill and legs
art.build: A medium-sized, slim, long-tailed bunting, a little larger than a sparrow, with a rounded head and upright stance. Bill conical, fairly long and pointed for a bunting, pink, shorter than the head. Legs pink. Long wings: at rest the primaries project well beyond the tertials. Tail medium-long and notched, with white outer feathers.
avoid: Do not paint a blue-grey head with a whitish throat — that is Grey-necked Bunting; Ortolan's head is olive-grey with a yellow throat and moustache.
Do not paint a white belly; the underparts below the breast band are cinnamon-orange.
Do not omit the pale yellowish eye-ring, and do not make the bill grey or dark; it is pink.
Do not paint a chestnut rump or yellow underparts (Yellowhammer).
